# Host profiles

Synthetic-only prototype. Nothing here is a clinical-deployment, SMART-certification, vendor-support or protocol-compatibility claim.

Schema `host-profiles/1`, workflow `recent-labs-v1`.

Zero verified structured-delivery cells ship. A real-host smoke test recorded wire frames and transcripts for Claude Code 2.1.309 in the modern era against the synthetic fixture and HAPI FHIR 8.12.0; these are smoke captures of an earlier schema-0.2 build, not a paired wire/model-input verification or a verified structured-delivery registry cell. structured-evidence-v1 is reachable only through the test-only registry override (labelled UNVERIFIED_DELIVERY_PROFILE); public config without a verified entry fails startup with UNVERIFIED_HOST_PROFILE and full-text-v1 remains the default.

## Registry entries

No entries: no host delivery cell is verified.

An entry records: `id`, `version`, `host{name,version,client_stack,client_stack_version}`, `era`, `transport:stdio`, `workflow:recent-labs-v1`, `delivery_profile`, `verification:verified|unverified|fixture_only`, `trace_sha256`, `model_input_sha256`, `tests`, `checked_at`.

## Outside-host smoke evidence

A smoke test ran Claude Code 2.1.309 through the scripted task list over stdio in the 2026-07-28 era, with gateway build `0.2.0-alpha.1` (application schema 0.2), against the synthetic source and against HAPI FHIR 8.12.0. It is evidence for that host, era and build only, not for later builds. It is not a registry entry and does not verify `structured-evidence-v1`.
